description: Optimized curved conformal 2.4 GHz patch (issue #1087): base and moved coordinates of the substrate-top surface nodes (the patch nodes among them, is_patch) with the patch and substrate-top triangles, bent frame. The ground plane is physically unchanged (its mesh nodes slide tangentially under outline DOFs only) and is not dumped. Consumed by the Meep matched-geometry work (#1088) and benchmarks/patch_antenna_conformal/scripts/plot_patch_displacement.py.
frame: bent fixture coordinates (x, y, z); bend axis parallel to y through (x = 0, z = z_axis_mm); chart s = R*atan2(x, z - z_axis), y
outline_basis: 4 clamped uniform B-splines (degree 3) per patch edge [+y, -y, +s, -s], each DOF moving its edge outward in the surface by 1 mm per unit; carried into the slab by a smoothstep ramp from the pinned feed band (half-width 0.80 mm) to the edge on every substrate node (top, interior, ground) and decaying over the 12 mm margin
